text:
maria: quick check — Acme enterprise asked for per-customer flags for the new streaming API. They want allowlist + contract-gating + VIP override. planning: small canary (1%) -> ramp (10%) if telemetry looks good. any blockers?

aj: runtime question — are we enforcing at the gateway layer or in-service? gating implementation affects rollback speed.

maria: good call. plan is tenant-scoped flag in flag-service (runtime check in gateway for fast path), with a secondary enforcement in the service for safety. gateway toggle = immediate global effect, service check = double safety.

aj: sgtm. do we have a sample flag payload?

maria: here's a draft config we use for customer-scoped toggles:
```json
{
  "flag_key": "streaming_api_v2",
  "targets": [
    {"type": "allowlist", "tenants": ["acme-corp"]},
    {"type": "contract_gate", "contracts": ["ACME-ENT-2026"]},
    {"type": "percent_rollout", "value": 1}
  ],
  "overrides": {"vip_accounts": true},
  "kill_switch": true
}
```

maria: note: VIP override only applies if account has entitlement flag in billing service.

devin: for canary, can we do a tenant slice + percent? e.g., 100% for acme-corp in canary window while overall percent remains 1% for others.

maria: yes — flag-service supports scoped slices: we can create a slice for tenant acme-corp = 100% in canary, plus global percent for everyone else. that lets Acme see full behavior without affecting global users.

product-dave: important: billing/product wants contract gating enforced BEFORE feature enable — we cannot accidentally enable for accounts outside contracted entitlements. how are we validating contract IDs?

maria: billing-service exposes contract metadata via internal API /v1/contracts/{tenant}. we will validate contract_id in the flag evaluation flow. also will add audit logs for any positive evaluations.

sarah: ops note — ensure entitlements sync runs before rollout. we had a lag last time and a few accounts slipped through. can we add a preflight job?

maria: yes. plan: run entitlement-sync job, verify 0 drift, then trigger canary. I'll add a preflight checklist in the PR.

lee: security question — for VIP override, limit to explicit admin roles. don't allow self-service toggles from tenant admins. Also require approval code in the flag metadata for emergency overrides.

maria: agreed. we'll gate VIP override behind org-admin + "vip_override" RBAC role and require an approval_id field in the flag eval context for manual overrides.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-job -> 2026-07-21T15:00Z. Monitoring hook: canary-monitor (latency, error-rate, token-cost).

devin: who owns the canary monitor run? eng-sre or the product oncall?

maria: eng-sre to watch infra metrics, dev-squad (me + devin) to watch quality/regressions, product-dave to confirm UX. I'll ping the oncalls as we start.

product-dave: also capture qualitative feedback from Acme CSM during canary. they should have access to a private feedback channel.

maria: noted — will loop in CSM and create a private thread.

aj: PR/CR plan? which repos?

maria: two PRs: 1) flag-service schema update + admin UI changes (platform/flags), 2) gateway guard + evaluation call (infra/gateway). I'll include runbook and rollout JSON in the PR description. reviewers: @aj for gateway, @lee for sec, @devin for flag-service impl.

lee: quick +1 on principle, will review sec details in PR.

devin: can review implementation tomorrow morning.

maria: ok i'll open PRs now and tag reviewers. running preflight entitlement-sync at 14:30 UTC. I'll update this thread with PR links and runbook checklist. thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reaction by maria :eyes:

maria: follow-up — added runbook snippet:
```text
Preflight:
- run entitlement-sync job (verify no drift)
- smoke test with Acme dev tenant (create stream job, assert 200)
- confirm audit logging enabled
Canary (15m):
- 100% Acme slice, global 1%
- monitor latency (p95), errors (5xx), token burn
- abort if p95 > baseline + 200ms OR errors increase > 2x
Rollback:
- trigger kill_switch via flag-service (instant)
- run incident playbook and notify CSM
```

maria: PRs: platform/flags#482 and infra/gateway#210 — tagging reviewers.

product-dave: thanks — thumbs up from product.

aj: noted potential edge: multi-tenant proxies that cache flag decisions — ensure cache keys include tenant_id to avoid leakage. I'll add test coverage.

maria: good catch. adding cache-key note in the gateway PR.

sarah: also add automated smoke alerts to PagerDuty if canary triggers threshold.

maria: will wire PD integration.

lee: when PRs merge, let's coordinate a quick post-merge verification window (5m) to confirm flags are served correctly.

maria: agreed. thanks everyone — will update when preflight completes.
